authoring_rule: Authored by a subagent from the six contract definitions and four control-category descriptions ONLY. It was explicitly barred from reading config/default-triggers.json, config/fallback-registry.json, hooks/, and the thirteen development prompts in tests/probes/intent-routing/cases.json, and it recorded zero tool uses, so it read no repository file at all. The session lead had ALREADY read the trigger regexes and the scorer while diagnosing the defects, and therefore could not author these: a prompt fitted to a regex makes the router agree with itself.
frozen: Committed BEFORE any discriminator or scorer change was written, so the separation between acceptance data and implementation is a matter of git history rather than assertion. Do not add or reword cases to make a fix pass.

categories.second_opinion: one other model, prior answer EXCLUDED
categories.answer_critique: one other model, prior answer INCLUDED
categories.standalone_panel: several models, same prompt, raw attributed answers, NOT merged
categories.debate: participants deliberately interact; independence not claimed
categories.synthesized_plan: independent plans gathered THEN merged, disagreement retained
categories.none: no other model wanted; ordinary question about the code
categories.mixed: consultation AND development work in one prompt; the chain must survive
categories.continuation: resume work already in progress after a detour
categories.development: ordinary development work; several deliberately use design/architecture/plan vocabulary in an ORDINARY sense, because those words are the likeliest false-match source
